certificate.description: Ribbon Communications Encryption Module TM400ENB is a hardware cryptographic module implemented as a multiple chip embedded module that operates as a line card in Ribbon Communications 's Apollo product line. In the networking parlance it's a transponder with multiplexing and encryption capabilities.
